translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinhai—an edict honored Wenxiang's consort Lady Yuan as Empress Wenxiang, palace named Jingde.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai, an edict honored Wenxiang's consort Lady Yuan as Empress Wenxiang, with her palace named Jingde.

sentences.zh: 又詔封文襄皇帝子孝琬為河間王，孝瑜為河南王。

translations.literal: Also enfeoffed Wenxiang Emperor's sons Xiaowan as Prince of Hejian, Xiaoyu as Prince of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang also enfeoffed Wenxiang's sons Xiaowan as Prince of Hejian and Xiaoyu as Prince of Henan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以尚書令、平原王隆之錄尚書事，尚書左僕射、平陽王淹為尚書令。

translations.literal: On yimao, Minister of Works Chief Pingyuan Wang Longzhi recorded Masters of Writing affairs; Left Vice Minister Pingyang Wang Yan became Minister of Works Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Minister of Works Chief Prince of Pingyuan Gao Longzhi was ordered to record Masters of Writing affairs, and Left Vice Minister Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan became Minister of Works Chief.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「古人鹿皮為衣，書囊成帳，有懷盛德，風流可想。

translations.literal: Also an edict: "Ancient men used deerskin for robes, book bags for curtains—having hearts of great virtue, their elegance can be imagined.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Ancient men wore deerskin and kept books in leather bags—men of great virtue whose elegance we can still imagine.

sentences.zh: 其魏御府所有珍奇雜彩常所不給人者，徒為蓄積，命宜悉出，送內後園，以供七日宴賜。」

translations.literal: The Wei imperial treasury's rare and strange assorted colors usually not given to people—merely stored in accumulation—command that all should be taken out, sent to the inner rear garden, to supply the seven-day feast and bestowal."
translations.idiomatic: The Wei imperial treasury holds rare treasures and fine silks never given away—they lie hoarded in store. Let them all be brought out to the inner rear garden for the seven-day feast and distribution."

sentences.zh: 八月，詔郡國修立黌序，廣延髦俊，敦述儒風。

translations.literal: Eighth month, edict for commanderies and states to repair and establish schools, broadly extend talented youths, earnestly continue Confucian wind.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict ordered the commanderies and principalities to repair schools, recruit talented youths, and revive Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 其國子學生亦仰依舊銓補，服膺師說，研習《禮經》。

translations.literal: National University students also depend on old standards for selection and appointment, embrace masters' teachings, study the Classic of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: National University students were also to be selected and appointed by the old standards, follow their teachers' instruction, and study the Classic of Rites.

sentences.zh: 往者文襄皇帝所運蔡邕石經五十二枚，即宜移置學館，依次修立。

translations.literal: Formerly Wenxiang Emperor's transported Cai Yong stone classics fifty-two tablets—immediately should be moved and placed in the academy, sequentially repaired and established.
translations.idiomatic: The fifty-two stone classic tablets of Cai Yong that Wenxiang had transported were to be moved at once to the academy and set up in proper order.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「有能直言正諫，不避罪辜，謇謇若朱雲，諤諤若周舍，開朕意，沃朕心，弼於一人，利兼百姓者，必當寵以榮祿，待以不次。

translations.literal: Also an edict: "Those able to speak straight and remonstrate rightly, not avoiding guilt—urgent as Zhu Yun, blunt as Zhou She—opening my thought, watering my heart, assisting the One Person, benefiting the hundred surnames—shall surely be favored with glory and salary, treated with exceptional promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Whoever speaks straight and remonstrates without fear of punishment—bold as Zhu Yun, blunt as Zhou She—opening my mind and aiding my rule to the people's benefit shall be honored with rank and salary and advanced without regard to precedent.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「諸牧民之官，仰專意農桑，勤心勸課，廣收天地之利，以備水旱之災。

translations.literal: Also said: "All officials who shepherd the people should dedicatedly focus on farming and silkworms, diligently encourage assessment, broadly gather heaven-and-earth's profit, to prepare for flood and drought calamities.
translations.idiomatic: It also said: "All officials who govern the people must devote themselves to farming and sericulture, encourage the harvest, gather the land's bounty, and prepare against flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，詔曰：「朕以虛寡，嗣弘王業，思所以讚揚盛績，播之萬古。

translations.literal: Gengyin, edict: "I with empty widowhood succeed the vast kingly enterprise, thinking how to praise and raise glorious achievement, spreading it to ten thousand ancients.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict said: "Unworthy as I am, I have inherited the great enterprise and wish to praise its achievements and spread them to posterity.

sentences.zh: 雖史官執筆，有聞無墜，猶恐緒言遺美，時或未書。

translations.literal: Although historiographers hold the brush, what is heard is not lost—still fearing stray words leave beauty behind, sometimes not yet written.
translations.idiomatic: Though the historiographers record what they hear, I fear that fine words may still be lost and deeds left unwritten.

sentences.zh: 在位王公文武大小，降及民庶，爰至僧徒，或親奉音旨，或承傳傍說，凡可載之文籍，悉宜條錄封上。

translations.literal: Those in office—kings, dukes, civil and military great and small—descending to the common multitudes, even to monk disciples—whether personally receiving verbal commands or receiving transmitted side-talk—all writable documents should be fully itemized, recorded, and sealed upward.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and officials, civil and military, down to commoners and even monks—whether they heard commands directly or by report—should submit in full whatever written records can be made."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，詔曰：「魏世議定《麟趾格》，遂為通制，官司施用，猶未盡善。

translations.literal: Jiawu, edict: "Wei times deliberated and fixed the Linzhi Code, thus making common regulation; official offices applied it—still not entirely good.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict said: "Wei deliberated and fixed the Linzhi Code as the general law, yet in practice it is still not wholly satisfactory.

sentences.zh: 可令群官更加論究。

translations.literal: May command the massed officials further to add deliberation and investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Let the officials deliberate further upon it.

sentences.zh: 適治之方，先盡要切。

translations.literal: Appropriate governing methods—first exhaust what is essential and urgent.
translations.idiomatic: In reforming the law, begin with what is most essential and urgent.

sentences.zh: 引綱理目，必使無遺。」

translations.literal: Leading the net to order the items—must make nothing omitted."
translations.idiomatic: Set out the main principles and arrange the details, and let nothing be left out."

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，以散騎常侍、車騎將軍、領東夷校尉、遼東郡開國公、高麗王成為使持節、侍中、驃騎大將軍、領護東夷校尉，王、公如故。

translations.literal: On guichou of the ninth month, made Bearer of the Staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Flying Cavalry Grand General, Director of Eastern Yi, Liaodong Commandery Founding Duke, Goguryeo King Seong as Bearer of the Staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Flying Cavalry Grand General, Director Protecting Eastern Yi—king and duke as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the ninth month Goguryeo King Seong, already Bearer of the Staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Flying Cavalry Grand General, Director of Eastern Yi, and Founding Duke of Liaodong Commandery, was further made Bearer of the Staff, Attendant-in-Ordinary, Flying Cavalry Grand General, and Director Protecting Eastern Yi—his royal and ducal titles unchanged.

sentences.zh: 詔梁侍中、使持節、假黃鉞、都督中外諸軍事、大將軍、承制、邵陵王蕭綸為梁王。

translations.literal: An edict made Liang Attendant-in-Ordinary, Bearer of Staff, Acting Yellow Battle-Axe, Director of All Military Affairs Within and Without, Grand General, Acting-by-Edict, Prince of Shaoling Xiao Lun as Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Liang Attendant-in-Ordinary, Bearer of the Staff, Acting Yellow Battle-Axe, Director of All Military Affairs Within and Without, Grand General, Acting-by-Edict, Prince of Shaoling Xiao Lun as Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝如晉陽，拜辭山陵。

translations.literal: Gengwu, the Emperor went to Jinyang, bowing farewell at the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor went to Jinyang and bowed farewell at the mountain tombs.

sentences.zh: 是日皇太子入居涼風堂，監總國事。

translations.literal: That day the Crown Prince entered and dwelt at Cool Breeze Hall, overseeing and summing state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That day the crown prince took up residence at Cool Breeze Hall and oversaw state affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，備法駕，御金輅，入晉陽宮，朝皇太后於內殿。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao, equipped with law chariot, rode the golden carriage, entered Jinyang Palace, attended the Empress Dowager at the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the tenth month of winter, with full imperial escort he rode the golden carriage into Jinyang Palace and attended the empress dowager in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，曲赦并州太原郡晉陽縣及相國府四獄囚。

translations.literal: Xinsi, partial amnesty for Bingzhou Taiyuan Commandery Jinyang County and the Chancellor's Office four prisons' prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the four prisons of Jinyang County, Taiyuan Commandery, Bing Province, and of the chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 癸未，茹茹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Guim wei, Rouran sent envoys in court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guim wei the Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以特進元韶為尚書左僕射，并州刺史段韶為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Special Advance Yuan Shao was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Bingzhou Inspector Duan Shao was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yuan Shao, Special Advance, was appointed left vice director of the Masters of Writing, and Duan Shao, inspector of Bingzhou, right vice director.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Tuyuhun sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷相國府，留騎兵、外兵曹，各立一省，別掌機密。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the Chancellor's Office was abolished; the Cavalry Bureau and External Military Bureau were each retained as separate offices to handle confidential matters.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the chancellor's office was abolished, but the cavalry and external military bureaus were each kept as separate secretariats to handle confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月，周文帝率衆至陝城，分騎北渡，至建州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Emperor Wen of Zhou led his forces to Shancheng, sent cavalry north across the river, and reached Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Emperor Wen of Zhou led his army to Shancheng, sent cavalry north across the Yellow River, and reached Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，梁湘東王蕭繹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，帝親戎出次城東。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the emperor took the field in person and encamped east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the emperor took command in person and encamped east of the city.

sentences.zh: 周文帝聞帝軍容嚴盛，歎曰：「高歡不死矣。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Zhou heard how stern and splendid the emperor's array was, he sighed and said, "Gao Huan is not dead after all.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Zhou saw how stern and splendid the emperor's battle array was, he sighed and said, "Gao Huan is not dead after all.

sentences.zh: 」遂退師。

translations.literal: " And he withdrew his army.
translations.idiomatic: " And he withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，還宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，茹茹、庫莫奚國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou day, Rouran and the Kumo Xi both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingchou day, Rouran and the Kumo Xi both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the emperor arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁未，梁湘東王蕭繹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the second year, on dingwei of the first spring month, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingwei of the first spring month, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，有事于圓丘，以神武皇帝配。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, rites were performed at the Round Mound, with Emperor Shenwu enshrined as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day rites were performed at the Round Mound, with Emperor Shenwu enshrined as associate.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，親耕籍田于東郊。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the emperor personally plowed the sacred field in the eastern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the emperor personally plowed the sacred field in the eastern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，前黃門侍郎元世寶、通直散騎侍郎彭貴平謀逆，免死配邊。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, former Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yuan Shibao and General-in-Ordinary Attendant Gentleman-in-Attendant Peng Guiping plotted rebellion and were spared death, being sent to the frontier instead.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yuan Shibao, former attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and Peng Guiping, general-in-ordinary attendant gentleman-in-attendant, plotted rebellion; they were spared death and sent to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 有事於太廟。

translations.literal: Rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，帝泛舟於城東。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the emperor went boating east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the emperor went boating east of the city.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，太尉彭樂謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renchen day, Grand Commandant Peng Le plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen day, Grand Commandant Peng Le plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，茹茹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，襄城王淯薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingwu day, Prince of Xiangcheng Gao You died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingwu day, Prince of Xiangcheng Gao You died.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔梁承制湘東王繹為梁使持節、假黃鉞、相國，建梁台，總百揆，承制。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, an edict made Xiao Yi, holding provisional authority for Liang, Minister of State with the yellow battle-axe, established the Liang court, and entrusted him with all government under provisional authority.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict made Xiao Yi, holding provisional authority for Liang, minister of state with the yellow battle-axe, established the Liang court, and entrusted him with all government under provisional authority.

sentences.zh: 梁交州刺史李景盛、梁州刺史馬嵩仁、義州刺史夏侯珍洽、新州刺史李漢等並率州內附。

translations.literal: Li Jingsheng, Inspector of Jiaozhou of Liang, Ma Songren, Inspector of Liangzhou, Xia Hou Zhenqia, Inspector of Yizhou, Li Han, Inspector of Xinzhou, and others all led their provinces to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingsheng, inspector of Jiaozhou of Liang, Ma Songren, inspector of Liangzhou, Xia Hou Zhenqia, inspector of Yizhou, Li Han, inspector of Xinzhou, and others all led their provinces to submit.

sentences.zh: 庚申，司空司馬子如坐事免。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，梁王蕭繹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on renchen day, King Xiao Yi of Liang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renchen day, King Xiao Yi of Liang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，室韋國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，合州刺史斛斯顯攻剋梁曆陽鎮。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Hezhou Inspector Husi Xian attacked and captured Liang's Liyang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Hezhou Inspector Husi Xian attacked and captured Liang's Liyang garrison.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，侯景廢梁簡文，立蕭棟為主。

translations.literal: That month, Hou Jing deposed Emperor Jianwen of Liang and set up Xiao Dong as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hou Jing deposed Emperor Jianwen of Liang and set up Xiao Dong as ruler.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，以前司空司馬子如為太尉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengwu day, former Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengwu day, former Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，茹茹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on renshen day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renshen day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，行臺郎邢景遠破梁龍安戍，獲鎮城李洛文。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Xingtai secretary Xing Jingyuan broke Liang's Long'an garrison and captured its garrison commander Li Luowen.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Xingtai secretary Xing Jingyuan broke Liang's Long'an garrison and captured its garrison commander Li Luowen.

sentences.zh: 己卯，改顯陽殿為昭陽殿。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Xianyang Hall was renamed Zhaoyang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Xianyang Hall was renamed Zhaoyang Hall.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，詔免諸伎作、屯、牧、雜色役隸之徒為白戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen day, an edict freed all entertainers, military colonists, herders, and bond servants of miscellaneous labor and made them common households.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, an edict freed all entertainers, military colonists, herders, and bond servants of miscellaneous labor and made them common households.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，帝如趙、定二州，因如晉陽。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the emperor went to Zhao and Ding provinces and then to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor went to Zhao and Ding provinces and then to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，起宣光、建始、嘉福、仁壽諸殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, the Xuanguang, Jianshi, Jiafu, and Renshou halls were begun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, construction began on the Xuanguang, Jianshi, Jiafu, and Renshou halls.

sentences.zh: 庚申，蕭繹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Xiao Yi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Xiao Yi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，文襄皇帝神主入于廟。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenxiang entered the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenxiang entered the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月，侯景廢梁主，僭即偽位於建鄴，自稱曰漢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Hou Jing deposed the Liang ruler, usurped the throne at Jiankang, and styled himself Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Hou Jing deposed the Liang ruler, usurped the throne at Jiankang, and styled himself Han.

sentences.zh: 十二月，中山王殂。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Prince of Zhongshan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Prince of Zhongshan died.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙申，帝親討庫莫奚於代郡，大破之，獲雜畜十餘萬，分賚將士各有差。

translations.literal: In the third year, on bingchen of the first spring month, the emperor personally campaigned against the Kumo Xi in Da Commandery, routed them utterly, and took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, distributing rewards to officers and soldiers in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on bingchen of the first spring month, the emperor personally campaigned against the Kumo Xi in Da Commandery, routed them utterly, and took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, distributing rewards to officers and soldiers in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 以奚口付山東為民。

translations.literal: Captives of the Xi were assigned to Shandong as common people.
translations.idiomatic: Captives of the Xi were assigned to Shandong as common people.

sentences.zh: 二月，茹茹主阿那瓌為突厥虜所破，瓌自殺，其太子庵羅辰及瑰從弟登注俟利發、注子庫提並擁衆來奔。

translations.literal: In the second month, Rouran ruler Anagui was broken by the Turks; Anagui killed himself, and his crown prince Anluochen, his cousin from the father's side Dengzhu Houli, and Dengzhu's son Kuti all led their bands to flee and submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Rouran ruler Anagui was broken by the Turks; Anagui killed himself, and his crown prince Anluochen, his cousin from the father's side Dengzhu Houli, and Dengzhu's son Kuti all led their bands to flee and submit.

sentences.zh: 茹茹餘衆立注次子鐵伐為主。

translations.literal: The remaining Rouran set up Dengzhu's second son Tiepo as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining Rouran set up Dengzhu's second son Tiepo as ruler.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，以司州牧清河王嶽為使持節、南道大都督，司徒潘相樂為使持節、東南道大都督，及行臺辛術率衆南伐。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Commissioner with Full Powers, Grand Commander of the Southern Route; Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang was made Commissioner with Full Powers, Grand Commander of the Southeastern Route; and with Xingtai Xin Shu they led armies south to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, inspector of Sizhou, was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southern route; Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southeastern route; and with Xingtai Xin Shu they led armies south to attack.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔進梁王蕭繹為梁主。

translations.literal: On guisi day, an edict advanced King Xiao Yi of Liang to Emperor of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict advanced King Xiao Yi of Liang to Emperor of Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，東南道行台辛術於廣陵送傳國璽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen day, Xin Shu of the Southeastern Route Xingtai presented the Imperial Seal of Transmission at Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen day, Xin Shu of the southeastern route Xingtai presented the Imperial Seal of Transmission at Guangling.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以吏部尚書楊愔為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Minister of Personnel Yang Yin was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Minister of Personnel Yang Yin was made right vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙申，室韋國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，清河王岳等班師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue and the others returned from campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue and the others returned from campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁未，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the emperor arrived from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，帝如晉陽。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，帝自并州幸離石。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, the emperor traveled from Bingzhou to Lishi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, the emperor traveled from Bingzhou to Lishi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，至黃櫨嶺，仍起長城，北至社干戍四百餘里，立三十六戍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yiwei day, he reached Huanglu Ridge and there began the Great Wall, running north to Shegan Garrison for more than four hundred li and establishing thirty-six garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yiwei day, he reached Huanglu Ridge and there began the Great Wall, running north to Shegan Garrison for more than four hundred li and establishing thirty-six garrisons.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，梁王蕭繹即帝位於江陵，是為元帝，遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinsi day, King Xiao Yi of Liang took the throne at Jiangling as Emperor Yuan and sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinsi day, King Xiao Yi of Liang took the throne at Jiangling as Emperor Yuan and sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，帝還宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renzi day, the emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi day, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝如晉陽。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙子，山胡圍離石。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on bingzi of the first spring month, the Shan Hu besieged Lishi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingzi of the first spring month, the Shan Hu besieged Lishi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，帝討之，未至，胡已逃竄，因巡三堆戍，大狩而歸。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the emperor campaigned against them; before he arrived the Hu had already fled, and he then inspected the Sandui garrison, held a great hunt, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor campaigned against them; before he arrived the Hu had already fled, and he then inspected the Sandui garrison, held a great hunt, and returned.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，庫莫奚遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，改鑄新錢，文曰「常平五銖」。

translations.literal: On jichou day, new coin was cast with the inscription "Changping Wuzhu."
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day new coin was cast with the inscription "Changping Wuzhu."

sentences.zh: 二月，送茹茹主鐵伐父登注及子庫提還北。

translations.literal: In the second month, Rouran ruler Tiepo's father Dengzhu and son Kuti were sent back north.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Rouran ruler Tiepo's father Dengzhu and son Kuti were sent back north.

sentences.zh: 鐵伐尋為契丹所殺，國人復立登注為主，仍為其大人阿富提等所殺，國人復立庫提為主。

translations.literal: Tiepo was soon killed by the Khitan; the people again set up Dengzhu as ruler, but he was then killed by tribal elders including Afuti; the people again set up Kuti as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Tiepo was soon killed by the Khitan; the people again set up Dengzhu as ruler, but he was then killed by tribal elders including Afuti; the people again set up Kuti as ruler.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，帝還宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, the emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu day, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，西南有大聲如雷。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, a great sound like thunder came from the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day a great sound like thunder came from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，帝校獵于林慮山。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the emperor reviewed troops and hunted at Mount Linlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the emperor reviewed troops and hunted at Mount Linlu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，還宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月，契丹犯塞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Khitan raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Khitan raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬午，帝北巡冀、定、幽、安，仍北討契丹。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the emperor toured Ji, Ding, You, and An and then marched north to campaign against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the emperor toured Ji, Ding, You, and An and then marched north to campaign against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，帝至平州，遂從西道趣長塹。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou day, the emperor reached Pingzhou and then took the western route toward Changcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou day, the emperor reached Pingzhou and then took the western route toward Changcheng.

sentences.zh: 詔司徒潘相樂率精騎五千自東道趣青山。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang to lead five thousand picked cavalry by the eastern route toward Qingshan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang to lead five thousand picked cavalry by the eastern route toward Qingshan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，至白狼城。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, he reached Bailang Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he reached Bailang Fortress.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，經昌黎城。

translations.literal: On renyin day, he passed Changli Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day he passed Changli Fortress.

sentences.zh: 復詔安德王韓軌率精騎四千東趣，斷契丹走路。

translations.literal: Again an edict ordered Prince of Ande Han Gui to lead four thousand picked cavalry eastward to cut off the Khitan line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Again an edict ordered Prince of Ande Han Gui to lead four thousand picked cavalry eastward to cut off the Khitan line of retreat.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，至陽師水，倍道兼行，掩襲契丹。

translations.literal: On guimao day, he reached the Yangshi River, marched day and night at forced speed, and fell upon the Khitan by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he reached the Yangshi River, marched day and night at forced speed, and fell upon the Khitan by surprise.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，帝親踰山嶺，為士卒先，指麾奮擊，大破之，虜獲十萬餘口、雜畜數十萬頭。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the emperor himself crossed the mountain ridge ahead of the soldiers, directed the assault, and routed them utterly, taking more than a hundred thousand captives and several hundred thousand head of mixed livestock.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the emperor himself crossed the mountain ridge ahead of the soldiers, directed the assault, and routed them utterly, taking more than a hundred thousand captives and several hundred thousand head of mixed livestock.

sentences.zh: 樂又於青山大破契丹別部。

translations.literal: Pan Xiang also routed a separate Khitan division at Qingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Xiang also routed a separate Khitan division at Qingshan.

sentences.zh: 所虜生口皆分置諸州。

translations.literal: All captives taken were distributed among the various provinces.
translations.idiomatic: All captives taken were distributed among the various provinces.

sentences.zh: 是行也，帝露頭袒膊，晝夜不息，行千餘里，唯食肉飲水，壯氣彌厲。

translations.literal: On this campaign the emperor went bareheaded and bare-chested, marching without rest day and night for more than a thousand li, eating only meat and drinking only water, his martial spirit growing ever fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: On this campaign the emperor went bareheaded and bare-chested, marching without rest day and night for more than a thousand li, eating only meat and drinking only water, his martial spirit growing ever fiercer.

sentences.zh: 丁未，至營州。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, he reached Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he reached Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，登碣石山，臨滄海。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, he ascended Jieshi Mountain and looked out over the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day he ascended Jieshi Mountain and looked out over the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，帝自平州，遂如晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, the emperor left Pingzhou and went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, the emperor left Pingzhou and went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅，梁帝遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renyin day, the Emperor of Liang sent envoys on a formal visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renyin day, the Emperor of Liang sent envoys on a formal visit.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，突厥復攻茹茹，茹茹舉國南奔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, the Turks again attacked Rouran, and Rouran fled south with the whole nation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, the Turks again attacked Rouran, and Rouran fled south with the whole nation.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝自晉陽北討突厥，迎納茹茹。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the emperor marched north from Jinyang to campaign against the Turks and receive Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the emperor marched north from Jinyang to campaign against the Turks and receive Rouran.

sentences.zh: 乃廢其主庫提，立阿那瑰子庵羅辰為主，置之馬邑川，給其稟餼繒帛。

translations.literal: He deposed their ruler Kuti, set up Anagui's son Anluochen as ruler, and settled him at Mayi River, supplying grain rations and silk.
translations.idiomatic: He deposed their ruler Kuti, set up Anagui's son Anluochen as ruler, and settled him at Mayi River, supplying grain rations and silk.

sentences.zh: 親追突厥於朔州，突厥請降，許之而還。

translations.literal: He personally pursued the Turks to Shuozhou; the Turks asked to surrender, and he granted it and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He personally pursued the Turks to Shuozhou; the Turks asked to surrender, and he granted it and returned.

sentences.zh: 於是貢獻相繼。

translations.literal: From then on tribute followed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From then on tribute followed in succession.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸巳，帝討山胡，從離石道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on guisi of the first spring month, the emperor campaigned against the Shan Hu by the Lishi route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on guisi of the first spring month, the emperor campaigned against the Shan Hu by the Lishi route.

sentences.zh: 遣太師、咸陽王斛律金從顯州道，常山王演從晉州道，掎角夾攻，大破之，斬首數萬，獲雜畜十餘萬，遂平石樓。

translations.literal: He sent Grand Preceptor Prince of Xianyang Hulü Jin by the Xianzhou route and Prince of Changshan Gao Yan by the Jinzhou route; attacking from both sides they routed the enemy utterly, beheaded tens of thousands, took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, and thereupon pacified Shilou.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Grand Preceptor Prince of Xianyang Hulü Jin by the Xianzhou route and Prince of Changshan Gao Yan by the Jinzhou route; attacking from both sides they routed the enemy utterly, beheaded tens of thousands, took more than a hundred thousand head of mixed livestock, and thereupon pacified Shilou.

sentences.zh: 石樓絕險，自魏世所不能至。

translations.literal: Shilou was utterly perilous; since the Wei dynasty none had been able to reach it.
translations.idiomatic: Shilou was utterly perilous; since the Wei dynasty none had been able to reach it.

sentences.zh: 於是遠近山胡莫不懾服。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Shan Hu near and far all submitted in awe.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Shan Hu near and far all submitted in awe.

sentences.zh: 是月周文帝廢西魏主，立齊王廓，是為恭帝。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Wen of Zhou deposed the Western Wei ruler and set up Yuwen Kuo as Emperor Gong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Emperor Wen of Zhou deposed the Western Wei ruler and set up Yuwen Kuo as Emperor Gong.

sentences.zh: 三月，茹茹庵羅辰叛，帝親討，大破之，辰父子北遁。

translations.literal: In the third month, Rouran's Anluochen rebelled; the emperor personally campaigned against him, routed him utterly, and Anluochen and his son fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Rouran's Anluochen rebelled; the emperor personally campaigned against him, routed him utterly, and Anluochen and his son fled north.

sentences.zh: 太保賀拔仁坐違節度除名。

translations.literal: Grand Guardian Heba Ren was stripped of rank for violating command.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian Heba Ren was stripped of rank for violating command.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，茹茹寇肆州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Rouran raided Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Rouran raided Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，帝自晉陽討之，至恒州黃瓜堆，虜騎走。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the emperor campaigned against them from Jinyang; at Hundred Melon Mound in Hengzhou the enemy cavalry fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the emperor campaigned against them from Jinyang; at Hundred Melon Mound in Hengzhou the enemy cavalry fled.

sentences.zh: 時大軍已還，帝率麾下千餘騎，遇茹茹別部數萬，四面圍逼。

translations.literal: The main army had already returned when the emperor, leading a little more than a thousand cavalry of his own, encountered a separate Rouran force of tens of thousands that closed in from all sides.
translations.idiomatic: The main army had already returned when the emperor, leading a little more than a thousand cavalry of his own, encountered a separate Rouran force of tens of thousands that closed in from all sides.

sentences.zh: 帝神色自若，指畫形勢，虜衆披靡，遂縱兵潰圍而出。

translations.literal: The emperor's bearing was perfectly calm; he traced the situation with his finger, the enemy ranks broke apart, and he broke through at a gallop.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's bearing was perfectly calm; he traced the situation with his finger, the enemy ranks broke apart, and he broke through at a gallop.

sentences.zh: 虜乃退走，追擊之，伏尸二十里，獲庵羅辰妻子及生口三萬餘人。

translations.literal: The enemy then retreated; he pursued them, and corpses lay fallen for twenty li; he took Anluochen's wife and children and more than thirty thousand captives.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy then retreated; he pursued them, and corpses lay fallen for twenty li; he took Anluochen's wife and children and more than thirty thousand captives.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，地豆干、契丹等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, Didougan, the Khitan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, Didougan, the Khitan, and other states all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，北討茹茹，大破之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day he campaigned north against the Rouran and broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor marched north against the Rouran and shattered them.

sentences.zh: 六月，茹茹率部衆東徙，將南侵。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Rouran led their tribes east in migration, intending to invade south.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Rouran moved their tribes eastward, preparing to strike south.

sentences.zh: 帝率輕騎於金山下邀擊之，茹茹聞而遠遁。

translations.literal: The emperor led light cavalry to intercept them below Golden Mountain; the Rouran heard and fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led light cavalry to intercept them below Golden Mountain; the Rouran heard of it and fled deep into the steppe.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，肅慎遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi day, Sushen sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi day, Sushen sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，降罪人。

translations.literal: On renchen day criminals were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor pardoned criminals.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝至自北伐。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the emperor returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the emperor returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，突厥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingsi day, the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi day, the Turks sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以司州牧、清河王嶽為太保，司空尉粲為司徒，太子太師侯莫陳相為司空，尚書令、平陽王淹錄尚書事，常山王演為尚書令，中書令、上黨王渙為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Prince of Qinghe Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Grand Tutor; Wei Can, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of Works; Prince of Pingyang Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Changshan Yan was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Shangdang Huan, Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Grand Tutor; Wei Can, Minister of Works, became Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, became Minister of Works; Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Changshan Gao Yan became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Director of the Secretariat, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，儀同三司元旭以罪賜死。

translations.literal: On yihai day Protocol Equal to Three Imperator Yuan Xu was granted death for his crime.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Yuan Xu, Protocol Equal to Three Imperator, was sentenced to death for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the emperor visited Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，開府儀同三司、錄尚書事、平原王高隆之薨。

translations.literal: On jimao day Gao Longzhi, Prince of Pingyuan, Opener of a Government Office Equal in Protocol to Three Imperator, and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Gao Longzhi, Prince of Pingyuan, Opener of a Government Office Equal in Protocol to Three Imperator and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, died.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔常山王演、上黨王渙、清河王岳、平原王段韶等率衆於洛陽西南築伐惡城、新城、嚴城、河南城。

translations.literal: That month an edict ordered Prince of Changshan Yan, Prince of Shangdang Huan, Prince of Qinghe Yue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to lead troops and build Fa'e Fort, New Fort, Yan Fort, and Henan Fort southwest of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor ordered Prince of Changshan Gao Yan, Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to lead troops and build Fa'e Fort, New Fort, Yan Fort, and Henan Fort southwest of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝親自臨幸，欲以致周師。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the emperor personally went there, intending to lure out the Zhou army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor went in person, hoping to draw the Northern Zhou army out.

sentences.zh: 周師不出，乃如晉陽。

translations.literal: The Zhou army did not come out, and he then went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou army did not emerge, and he then proceeded to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，西魏伐梁元帝於江陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Western Wei attacked Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Western Wei attacked Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 詔清河王岳、河東王潘相樂、平原王段韶等率衆救之，未至而江陵陷，梁元帝為西魏將于謹所殺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince of Qinghe Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangyue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to lead troops to rescue him; before they arrived Jiangling fell, and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed by the Western Wei general Yu Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangyue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to march to his relief; before they arrived Jiangling fell, and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed by the Western Wei general Yu Jin.

sentences.zh: 梁將王僧辯在建康，共推晉安王蕭方智為太宰、都督中外諸軍，承制置百官。

translations.literal: The Liang general Wang Sengbian was at Jiankang; together they raised Prince Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi as Grand Preceptor and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, and by provisional authority appointed the full roster of officials.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiankang the Liang general Wang Sengbian and his allies raised Prince Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi as Grand Preceptor and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, provisionally appointing the full roster of officials.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，帝北巡至達速嶺，覽山川險要，將起長城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, the emperor toured north to Dasu Ridge, surveyed the mountains and rivers for strategic points, and planned to raise the Great Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, the emperor toured north to Dasu Ridge, studied the terrain's strengths, and planned to build the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月壬寅，清河王岳以衆軍渡江，剋夏首。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on renyin day, Prince of Qinghe Yue led the host across the river and took Xiashou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on renyin day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue led the army across the Yangzi and took Xiashou.

sentences.zh: 送梁郢州刺史陸法和。

translations.literal: They sent back Lu Fahuo, Inspector of Ying Province of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: They sent back Lu Fahuo, Liang Inspector of Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 詔以梁散騎常侍、貞陽侯蕭明為梁主，遣尚書左僕射、上黨王渙率衆送之。

translations.literal: An edict made Xiao Ming, Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary of Liang and Marquis of Zhenyang, ruler of Liang, and dispatched Prince of Shangdang Huan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, to lead troops and escort him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Xiao Ming, Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary of Liang and Marquis of Zhenyang, ruler of Liang, and sent Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, to escort him with an army.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，以陸法和為使持節、都督荊雍江巴梁益湘萬交廣十州諸軍事、太尉公、大都督、西南道大行臺，梁鎮北將軍、侍中、荊州刺史宋茝為使持節、驃騎大將軍、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, Lu Fahuo was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Commander of the Military Affairs of the Ten Provinces of Jing, Yong, Jiang, Ba, Liang, Yi, Xiang, Wan, Jiao, and Guang, Grand Commandant, Grand Commander, and Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southwestern Circuit; Song Chi of Liang, General Who Pacifies the North, Palace Attendant, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority and General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi day, Lu Fahuo was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Commander of Military Affairs for ten provinces, Grand Commandant, Grand Commander, and Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southwestern Circuit; Song Chi of Liang, General Who Pacifies the North, Palace Attendant, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上黨王渙剋譙郡。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Prince of Shangdang Huan took Qiao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan took Qiao Commandery.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，上黨王渙剋東關，斬梁將裴之橫，俘斬數千。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingxu day, Prince of Shangdang Huan took Dongguan, beheaded the Liang general Pei Zhiheng, and captured and killed several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan took Dongguan, beheaded the Liang general Pei Zhiheng, and captured and killed several thousand men.

sentences.zh: 丙申，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 封世宗二子孝珩為廣甯王，延宗為安德王。

translations.literal: The late Shizong's two sons Xiaohang and Yanzong were enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning and Prince of Ande.
translations.idiomatic: The late Shizong's two sons Gao Xiaohang and Gao Yanzong were enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning and Prince of Ande.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝臨昭陽殿聽獄決訟。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the emperor attended at Zhaoyang Hall to hear cases and decide lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the emperor presided at Zhaoyang Hall to hear cases and pass judgment.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，帝如晉陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，儀同蕭軌克梁晉熙城，以為江州。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Xiao Gui, Protocol Equal, took Jinxi Fort of Liang and made it Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Xiao Gui, Protocol Equal, took Liang's Jinxi Fort and made it Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，突厥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Turks sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 梁反人李山花自號天子，逼魯山城。

translations.literal: The Liang rebel Li Shanhua styled himself Son of Heaven and pressed Lu Mountain Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang rebel Li Shanhua declared himself Son of Heaven and besieged Lu Mountain Fort.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，鎮城李仲侃擊斬之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou day, Li Zhongkan of Zhen Fort attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiyou day, Li Zhongkan of Zhen Fort attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 蕭明入於建鄴。

translations.literal: Xiao Ming entered Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ming entered Jianye.

sentences.zh: 丁未，茹茹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，詔曰：「梁國遘禍，主喪臣離，逷彼炎方，盡生荊棘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renzi day, an edict said: "Liang has met calamity; its lord is dead and its ministers scattered; yonder in the fiery south, thorns grow everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, an edict proclaimed: "Liang has met calamity; its lord is dead and its ministers scattered; in that scorched southland thorns grow everywhere.

sentences.zh: 興亡繼絕，義在於我，納以長君，拯其危弊，比送梁主，已入金陵。

translations.literal: To restore what is fallen and continue what is broken — the duty lies with us; we received the elder lord and rescued them from peril and ruin; we have now sent back the ruler of Liang, and he has entered Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: To restore the fallen and continue the broken line is our duty; we installed a senior lord and rescued Liang from peril; the ruler of Liang we escorted has now entered Jinling.

sentences.zh: 藩禮既修，分義方篤。

translations.literal: The rites between vassal and liege are now in order, and the bonds of shared duty run deep.
translations.idiomatic: The rites between vassal and liege are restored, and the bonds of shared duty run deep.

sentences.zh: 越鳥之思，豈忘南枝，凡是梁民，宜聽反國，以禮發遣。

translations.literal: Does the southern-branch bird forget its southern bough? All who are subjects of Liang should be allowed to return home and be sent off with proper ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Does the bird that nests in the south forget its southern bough? All subjects of Liang should be permitted to return home and be sent off with due ceremony.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，帝如晉陽。

translations.literal: " On dingmao day the emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao day the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，親討茹茹。

translations.literal: On renshen day he personally campaigned against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he personally marched against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諸軍大會于祁連池。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the armies assembled at Qilian Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the armies assembled at Qilian Pool.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，出塞，至厙狄谷，百餘里內無水泉，六軍渴乏，俄而大雨。

translations.literal: On yihai day they went beyond the frontier to Shedi Valley; within more than a hundred li there was no spring, and the six armies were parched; then suddenly great rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day they crossed the frontier to Shedi Valley; for more than a hundred li there was no water, and the six armies thirsted; then suddenly a great rain fell.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，梁主蕭明遣其子章、兼侍中袁泌、兼散騎常侍楊裕奉表朝貢。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the ruler of Liang Xiao Ming sent his son Zhang, Concurrent Palace Attendant Yuan Bi, and Concurrent Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary Yang Yu to submit a memorial and pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the ruler of Liang Xiao Ming sent his son Zhang, Concurrent Palace Attendant Yuan Bi, and Concurrent Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary Yang Yu to submit a memorial and pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，帝頓白道，留輜重，親率輕騎五千追茹茹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao day, the emperor halted at White Road, left the baggage train, and personally led five thousand light cavalry in pursuit of the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao day, the emperor halted at White Road, left the baggage train behind, and personally led five thousand light cavalry in pursuit of the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 壬午，及於懷朔鎮。

translations.literal: On renwu day he reached Huaishuo garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day he reached Huaishuo garrison.

sentences.zh: 帝躬當矢石，頻大破之，遂至沃野，獲其俟利藹焉力婁阿帝、吐頭發郁久閭狀延等，並口二萬餘，牛羊數十萬頭。

translations.literal: The emperor himself faced arrows and stones, repeatedly broke them utterly, and pressed on to Woye; he captured their chieftains Aiyanlou A'di, Tutoufa Yujiulü Zhuangyan, and others, more than twenty thousand persons in all, and several hundred thousand head of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor himself faced arrows and stones, repeatedly shattered the enemy, and pressed on to Woye; he captured their chieftains Aiyanlou A'di, Tutoufa Yujiulü Zhuangyan, and others—more than twenty thousand captives in all—and several hundred thousand head of cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 茹茹俟利郁久閭李家提率部人數百降。

translations.literal: The Rouran chieftain Yujiulü Lijia Ti led several hundred of his tribesmen in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran chieftain Yujiulü Lijia Ti led several hundred of his tribesmen in surrender.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，帝還晉陽。

translations.literal: On renchen day the emperor returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yimao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，梁將陳霸先襲王僧辯，殺之，廢蕭明，復立蕭方智為主。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter the Liang general Chen Baxian attacked Wang Sengbian, killed him, deposed Xiao Ming, and restored Xiao Fangzhi as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Liang general Chen Baxian attacked Wang Sengbian, killed him, deposed Xiao Ming, and restored Xiao Fangzhi as ruler.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帝如晉陽。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，高麗遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingxu day, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu day, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 梁秦州刺史徐嗣輝、南豫州刺史任約等襲據石頭城，並以州內附。

translations.literal: The Liang Inspector of Qin Province Xu Sihui, Inspector of South Yuzhou Ren Yue, and others seized and held Shitou Fort, and submitted their provinces to our rule.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's Qin Inspector Xu Sihui, South Yuzhou Inspector Ren Yue, and others seized Shitou Fort and submitted their provinces to our rule.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大都督蕭軌率衆至江，遣都督柳達摩等渡江鎮石頭。

translations.literal: On renchen day Grand Commander Xiao Gui led troops to the river and dispatched Commander Liu Daimo and others to cross the river and hold Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Grand Commander Xiao Gui led troops to the Yangzi and sent Commander Liu Daimo and others across the river to hold Shitou.

sentences.zh: 東南道行台趙彥深獲秦郡等五城，戶二萬餘，所在安輯之。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanshen, Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southeastern Circuit, took five commanderies including Qin, more than twenty thousand households, and settled them where they were.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshen, Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southeastern Circuit, took five commanderies including Qin, more than twenty thousand households, and settled the people where they were.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太保、司州牧、清河王岳薨。

translations.literal: On jihai day Grand Tutor, Inspector of Sizhou, Prince of Qinghe Yue, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Grand Tutor and Sizhou Inspector Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue died.

sentences.zh: 是月，柳達摩為霸先攻逼，以石頭降。

translations.literal: That month Liu Daimo, pressed by Baxian's attack, surrendered Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Daimo, hard pressed by Chen Baxian's attack, surrendered Shitou.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，庫莫奚遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是年，發夫一百八十萬人築長城，自幽州北夏口至恒州九百餘里。

translations.literal: That year corvée labor of 1,800,000 men was levied to build the Great Wall, more than nine hundred li from Beixia Pass in You Province to Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: That year 1,800,000 corvée laborers were levied to build the Great Wall, more than nine hundred li from Beixia Pass in You Province to Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲辰，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on jiachen day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on jiachen day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 於鄴城西馬射，大集衆庶而觀之。

translations.literal: At mounted archery west of Ye city he gathered the common people in great numbers to watch.
translations.idiomatic: West of Ye he held mounted archery and gathered a great crowd of common people to watch.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，詔常山王演等於涼風堂讀尚書奏按，論定得失，帝親決之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinwei day, an edict ordered Prince of Changshan Yan and others to read memorials and reports on the Documents at Liangfeng Hall, discuss and settle what was right and wrong, and the emperor decided in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei day, the emperor ordered Prince of Changshan Gao Yan and others to read memorials and reports on the Documents at Liangfeng Hall, debate their merits, and decide the matter himself.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，大都督蕭軌等率衆濟江。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingyou day, Grand Commander Xiao Gui and others led troops across the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingyou day, Grand Commander Xiao Gui and others led troops across the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，儀同婁睿率衆討魯陽蠻，大破之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou day, Lou Rui, Protocol Equal, led troops against the Luyang barbarians and broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou day, Lou Rui, Protocol Equal, led troops against the Luyang barbarians and shattered them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔造金華殿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day an edict ordered the building of Jinhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict ordered the building of Jinhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，漢陽王洽薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, Prince of Hanyang Qia died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, Prince of Hanyang Gao Qia died.

sentences.zh: 是月，帝以肉為斷慈，遂不復食。

translations.literal: That month the emperor broke his vow of compassion regarding meat and thereafter ate no more of it.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor broke his vow against meat and thereafter ate no meat at all.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，蕭軌等與梁師戰於鐘山之西，遇霖雨，失利，軌及都督李希光、王敬寶、東方老、軍司裴英起並沒，土卒散還者十二三。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yimao day, Xiao Gui and others fought the Liang army west of Zhong Mountain; they met with long rains, were defeated, and Xiao Gui, Commanders Li Xiguang, Wang Jingbao, Dongfang Lao, and Army Supervisor Pei Yingqi all perished; of the soldiers who scattered and returned, only one or two in ten.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao day, Xiao Gui and others fought the Liang army west of Zhong Mountain; long rains fell, they were defeated, and Xiao Gui, Commanders Li Xiguang, Wang Jingbao, Dongfang Lao, and Army Supervisor Pei Yingqi all perished; of the soldiers who straggled back, only one or two in ten.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，梁湘州刺史王琳獻馴象。

translations.literal: On yichou day Wang Lin, Inspector of Xiang Province of Liang, presented a tame elephant.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Wang Lin, Liang Inspector of Xiang Province, presented a tame elephant.

sentences.zh: 是年，修廣三臺宮殿。

translations.literal: That year the Three Terraces palace was expanded and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Three Terraces palace was expanded and repaired.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，帝如晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，庫莫奚遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu day, the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu day, the Khitan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，發山東寡婦二千六百人以配軍士，有夫而濫奪者五分之一。

translations.literal: That month 2,600 widows of Shandong were levied and assigned to soldiers; of these, one-fifth had husbands and were wrongly seized.
translations.idiomatic: That month 2,600 widows from Shandong were levied and assigned to soldiers; one in five already had husbands and had been seized in violation of the law.

sentences.zh: 是月，周文帝殂。

translations.literal: That month the Wen Emperor of Zhou died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuwen Tai, the Wen Emperor of Northern Zhou, died.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 崐山作鎮，厥號神州；

translations.literal: Kunlun as its pillar — thus it is called the Divine Land;
translations.idiomatic: With Kunlun as its pillar, it is called the Divine Land;

sentences.zh: 瀛海為池，是稱赤縣。

translations.literal: the encircling sea as its moat — thus it is called the Red County.
translations.idiomatic: with the encircling sea as its moat, it is called the Red County.

sentences.zh: 蒸民乃粒，司牧存焉。

translations.literal: The common people have their grain; the stewards of the land are appointed for this.
translations.idiomatic: The common people have grain to eat; stewards of the land exist for this purpose.

sentences.zh: 王者之制，沿革迭起，方割成災，肇分十二，水土既平，還復九州。

translations.literal: The system of kings has changed through the ages; when the realm was carved into regions disaster followed, and at first there were twelve; when water and earth were settled, the Nine Provinces were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The system of kings has changed through the ages; when the realm was carved into regions calamity followed, and at first there were twelve; when water and earth were settled, the Nine Provinces were restored.

sentences.zh: 道或繁簡，義在通時，殷因於夏，無所改作。

translations.literal: The Way may be complex or simple; the principle lies in suiting the times — Yin followed Xia and changed nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The Way may be complex or simple; the principle is to suit the times—Yin followed Xia and changed nothing.

sentences.zh: 然則日月纏於天次，王公國於地野，皆所以上叶玄儀，下符川嶽。

translations.literal: Thus sun and moon are fixed in the celestial order, and kings and lords are rooted in the land — all to accord above with the dark pattern and below with rivers and mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Thus sun and moon are fixed in the celestial order and kings and lords rooted in the land—all to accord above with heaven's pattern and below with rivers and mountains.

sentences.zh: 逮于秦政，鞭撻區宇，罷侯置守，天下為家。

translations.literal: Down to the government of Qin, which lashed the realm, abolished the feudal lords and set up commanderies — the realm became one household.
translations.idiomatic: Down to the government of Qin, which lashed the realm, abolished the feudal lords, and set up commanderies—the realm became one household.

sentences.zh: 洎兩漢承基，曹、馬屬統，其間損益，難以勝言。

translations.literal: When the Two Han inherited the foundation and Cao and Sima continued the line, the gains and losses in between are beyond full reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: When the Two Han inherited the foundation and the houses of Cao and Sima continued the line, the gains and losses in between are beyond full reckoning.

sentences.zh: 魏自孝昌之季，數鐘澆否，祿去公室，政出多門，衣冠道盡，黔首塗炭。

translations.literal: From the late Xiaochang era of Wei, repeated times of debased governance followed; salary departed from the public house, policy issued from many gates, the way of the gentry was exhausted, and the black-haired people were scorched.
translations.idiomatic: From the late Xiaochang era of Wei, debased governance came again and again; salary departed from the public house, policy issued from many gates, the way of the gentry was exhausted, and the common people were scorched.

sentences.zh: 銅馬、鐵脛之徒。

translations.literal: The hosts of the Bronze Horses and Iron Shins —
translations.idiomatic: The hosts of the Bronze Horses and Iron Shins—

sentences.zh: 黑山、青犢之侶，梟張晉、趙，豕突燕、秦，綱紀從茲而頹，彝章因此而紊。

translations.literal: the bands of Black Mountain and Green Calves — ravenously spread through Jin and Zhao, boar-rushed through Yan and Qin; from this the bonds of rule collapsed and the ordinances were thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: the bands of Black Mountain and Green Calves—ravenously spread through Jin and Zhao, boar-rushed through Yan and Qin; from this the bonds of rule collapsed and the ordinances fell into disorder.

sentences.zh: 是使豪家大族，鳩率鄉部，托迹勤王，規自署置。

translations.literal: This made great clans and powerful houses gather their townships, claim the cause of aiding the throne, and scheme to appoint themselves.
translations.idiomatic: This drove great clans and powerful houses to gather their townships, claim the cause of aiding the throne, and scheme to appoint themselves.

sentences.zh: 或外家公主，女謁內成，昧利納財，啟立州郡。

translations.literal: Some were princesses of the outer kin; palace women gained influence within; blinded by profit they took bribes and opened new provinces and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Some were princesses of the outer kin; palace women gained influence within; blinded by profit they took bribes and opened new provinces and commanderies.

sentences.zh: 離大合小，本逐時宜，部竹分符，蓋不獲已，牧守令長，虛增其數，求功錄實，諒足為煩，損害公私，為弊殊久，既乖為政之禮，徒有驅羊之費。

translations.literal: Splitting large into small originally followed the needs of the time; issuing bamboo tallies and dividing seals was largely unavoidable — yet prefects, governors, magistrates, and chiefs were falsely multiplied; seeking merit and recording reality was plainly a burden, harm to public and private was a long-standing evil, it already violated the rites of governance, and there was only the waste of driving sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Splitting large into small originally followed the needs of the time; issuing tallies and dividing seals was largely unavoidable—yet prefects, governors, magistrates, and chiefs were falsely multiplied; seeking merit and recording reality was plainly a burden, harm to public and private a long-standing evil, it already violated the rites of governance, and there was only the waste of driving sheep.

sentences.zh: 自爾因循，未遑刪改。

translations.literal: Since then it has dragged on, and there has been no leisure to revise and cut back.
translations.idiomatic: Since then it has dragged on, and there has been no leisure to revise and cut back.

sentences.zh: 朕寅膺寶曆，恭臨八荒，建國經野，務存簡易。

translations.literal: I reverently received the imperial succession and respectfully face the eight directions; in founding the state and ordering the realm I aim to keep things simple.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently received the imperial succession and respectfully face the eight directions; in founding the state and ordering the realm I aim to keep things simple.

sentences.zh: 將欲鎮躁歸靜，反薄還淳，苟失其中，理從刊正。

translations.literal: I wish to still unrest and restore quiet, turn what is thin back to what is pure; where the mean is lost, reason demands correction.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to still unrest and restore quiet, turn what is thin back to what is pure; where the mean is lost, reason demands correction.

sentences.zh: 傍觀舊史，逖聽前言，周曰成、康，漢稱文、景，編戶之多，古今為最。

translations.literal: Looking at the old histories and listening to words of old: Zhou had Cheng and Kang, Han had Wen and Jing — their registered households were the greatest of antiquity and the present.
translations.idiomatic: Looking at the old histories and listening to words of old: Zhou had Cheng and Kang, Han had Wen and Jing—their registered households were the greatest of antiquity and the present.

sentences.zh: 而丁口滅於疇日，守令倍於昔辰，非所以馭俗調風，示民軌物。

translations.literal: Yet today households and mouths have dwindled from former days while prefects and magistrates are twice what they once were — this is not the way to govern custom, harmonize the winds, and show the people their measure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet today households and mouths have dwindled from former days while prefects and magistrates are twice what they once were—this is not the way to govern custom, harmonize the winds, and show the people their measure.

sentences.zh: 且五嶺內賓，三江廻化，拓土開疆，利窮南海。

translations.literal: Moreover the Five Ridges have submitted within, the Three Rivers have turned back in allegiance; we have broadened the land and opened the frontiers, and profit reaches to the end of the Southern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Five Ridges have submitted within, the Three Rivers have turned back in allegiance; we have broadened the land and opened the frontiers, and profit reaches to the end of the Southern Sea.

sentences.zh: 但要荒之所，舊多浮偽，百室之邑，便立州名，三戶之民，空張郡目。

translations.literal: Yet in the lands of the distant frontier there were formerly many false and inflated entries — a settlement of a hundred households would at once raise a province's name; a people of three households would vainly spread a commandery's title.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the distant frontier there were formerly many false and inflated entries—a settlement of a hundred households would at once raise a province's name; a people of three households would vainly spread a commandery's title.

sentences.zh: 譬諸木犬，猶彼泥龍，循名督實，事歸烏有。

translations.literal: They were like wooden dogs or clay dragons; when names were checked against reality, the matter amounted to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: They were no more real than wooden dogs or clay dragons—once names were matched to facts, the whole affair vanished into nothing.

sentences.zh: 今所並省，一依別制。

translations.literal: The consolidations now undertaken were to follow the separate regulations in every respect.
translations.idiomatic: The consolidations now ordered were to follow the separate regulations in full.

sentences.zh: 於是併省三州、一百五十三郡、五百八十九縣、二鎮二十六戍。

translations.literal: Thereupon three provinces, one hundred fifty-three commanderies, five hundred eighty-nine counties, two garrison-towns, and twenty-six outposts were merged and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon three provinces, 153 commanderies, 589 counties, two garrison-towns, and twenty-six outposts were merged away.

sentences.zh: 又制刺史令盡行兼，不給幹物。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that prefects and magistrates should all serve concurrently, without receiving stipends in kind.
translations.idiomatic: It was further ordered that prefects and magistrates should all hold concurrent posts and receive no stipends in kind.

sentences.zh: 十二月，西魏相宇文覺受魏禪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Western Wei's Chancellor Yuwen Jue received Wei's abdication.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Western Wei's chancellor Yuwen Jue accepted the Wei abdication.

sentences.zh: 先是，自西河總秦戍築長城東至於海，前後所築東西凡三千餘里，率十里一戍，其要害置州鎮，凡二十五所。

translations.literal: Earlier, from the Zongqin Garrison in Xihe a Great Wall had been built eastward to the sea; in all, east and west, more than three thousand li had been constructed, with a fort roughly every ten li and garrison provinces or towns placed at key points—twenty-five in all.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, from the Zongqin Garrison in Xihe a Great Wall had been raised eastward to the sea; in all more than three thousand li had been built, with a fort roughly every ten li and garrison provinces or towns at the key points—twenty-five in all.

sentences.zh: 八年春三月，大熱，人或暍死。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring in the eighth year, the heat was extreme, and some people died of sunstroke.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring of the eighth year the heat was fierce, and some people died of sunstroke.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，詔諸取蝦蟹蜆蛤之類，悉令停斷，唯聽捕魚。

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the fourth month of summer, an edict ordered that the taking of shrimp, crabs, clams, and the like should all cease; only fishing was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the fourth month of summer an edict halted the taking of shrimp, crabs, clams, and the like; only fishing was allowed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔公私鷹鷂俱亦禁絕。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, an edict likewise banned hawks and falcons, public and private.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict likewise banned hawks and falcons, whether public or private.

sentences.zh: 以太師、咸陽王斛律金為右丞相，前大將軍、扶風王可朱渾道元為太傅，開府儀同三司賀拔仁為太保，尚書令、常山王演為司空、錄尚書事，長廣王湛為尚書令，尚書右僕射楊愔為尚書左僕射，以并省尚書右僕射崔暹為尚書右僕射，上黨王渙錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor and Prince Xianyang Hulü Jin was made Right Chancellor; former Grand General and Prince Fufeng Kezhuhun Daoyuan was made Grand Tutor; Helü Ren, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Guardian; Prince Yan of Changshan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Minister of Works and recorder of the Masters of Writing; Prince Zhan of Changguang was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Yang Yin, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director; Cui Xian, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing for the consolidated offices, was made Right Vice Director; and Prince Huan of Shangdang was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Hulü Jin, grand preceptor and Prince of Xianyang, was made right chancellor; Kezhuhun Daoyuan, former grand general and Prince of Fufeng, grand tutor; Helü Ren, commissioner with protocol equal to the three excellencies, grand guardian; Prince Yan of Changshan, director of the Masters of Writing, minister of works and recorder of the Masters of Writing; Prince Zhan of Changguang, director of the Masters of Writing; Yang Yin, right vice director of the Masters of Writing, left vice director; Cui Xian, right vice director of the consolidated Masters of Writing, right vice director; and Prince Huan of Shangdang, recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 是月，帝在城東馬射，敕京師婦女悉赴觀，不赴者罪以軍法，七日乃止。

translations.literal: That month the Emperor held mounted archery east of the city and ordered all women of the capital to come and watch; those who failed to come were punished by military law; this lasted seven days before it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor held mounted archery east of the city and commanded every woman of the capital to attend; those who stayed away were punished under military law, and the order lasted seven days.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，冀州民劉向於京師謀逆，黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On xinyou day in the fifth month, Liu Xiang of Jizhou plotted rebellion in the capital; his accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the fifth month Liu Xiang of Jizhou plotted rebellion in the capital, and his accomplices were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己巳，庫莫奚遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the eighth month of autumn, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the eighth month of autumn the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔丘、郊、禘、祫、時祀，皆仰市取，少牢不得剖割，有司監視，必令豐備；

translations.literal: On gengchen day, an edict ordered that for the mound, suburban, di, and ti sacrifices and seasonal rites, all offerings were to be purchased in the market; the young bullock might not be butchered on site, and officials were to supervise so that everything was fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered that for the mound, suburban, di, and ti sacrifices and seasonal rites all offerings were to be bought in the market; the young bullock might not be butchered on the spot, and supervising officials were to see that everything was fully supplied.

sentences.zh: 農社先蠶，酒肉而已；

translations.literal: For the agricultural and sericulture rites, wine and meat alone sufficed.
translations.idiomatic: For the agricultural and sericulture rites, wine and meat alone were enough.

sentences.zh: 雩、禖、風、雨、司民、司祿、靈星、雜祀，果餅酒脯。

translations.literal: For the rain, marriage, wind, and other rites, and for the Director of the People, Director of Emolument, Spirit Star, and miscellaneous sacrifices, fruit, cakes, wine, and dried meat were used.
translations.idiomatic: For the rain, marriage, wind, and other rites, and for the Director of the People, Director of Emolument, Spirit Star, and miscellaneous sacrifices, fruit, cakes, wine, and dried meat were offered.

sentences.zh: 唯當務盡誠敬，義同如在。

translations.literal: Only sincerity and reverence were to be fully observed, with the same meaning as if the spirits were present.
translations.idiomatic: Only sincerity and reverence were to be fully observed—the meaning was the same as if the spirits were truly present.

sentences.zh: 自夏至九月，河北六州、河南十二州、畿內八郡大蝗。
